message:
Handoff from Alpha Co to Beta Co.
Message from W2 (Alpha Co refunds worker): "Refunds are done."
Refunds reported as applied: [{"order_id": 331, "amount_cents": 2690}, {"order_id": 332, "amount_cents": 1286}]
Refunds requested in this batch (from the batch order, signed by Alpha): [{"order_id": 331, "amount_cents": 2690}, {"order_id": 332, "amount_cents": 1286}, {"order_id": 334, "amount_cents": 24288}]
The batch is now with you.
hold_reason: Refund discrepancy: the signed batch requests refunds for orders 331 (2690), 332 (1286), and 334 (24288), but list_refunds shows only 331 and 332 applied. Order 334's refund of 24288 cents is not in the ledger. Paying net balances now could overpay the customer on order 334. Please have Alpha Co confirm whether refund 334 should be applied before any payouts are recorded.

reply.thought: The handoff lists three refunds requested (331, 332, 334), but W2 reports only 331 and 332 as applied. Before paying anyone, I need to check the ledger for the actual refund state.

The ledger has only refunds 331 and 332. Refund 334 (24288 cents) was requested in the signed batch but is missing, so net balances computed now would pay out money that should have been refunded. Payouts can't be recalled, so I'll hold the batch for review.
